confirmed_configuration_constraints.detail: Listener reads VISUA_PORT (default 8787), not generic PORT. Configure the platform container port to 8787 or supply VISUA_PORT explicitly. OIDC binds 0.0.0.0 by default.

Run scheduling, lease heartbeats, score-history capture and SSO domain rechecks are process timers. Select a hosting configuration that provides CPU and at least one running process independently of incoming requests; prove behavior across restarts and multiple instances.

Each process may use 10 pooled database connections plus one persistent LISTEN connection. Pool max has no environment setting in openStore. Bound application scaling/concurrency against the selected database connection budget; verify the chosen connection path supports LISTEN/NOTIFY.

Peer identity is the direct adapter socket, and forwarded headers are intentionally ignored. Behind a proxy, users may share the same peer bucket (1200/minute default; auth 120/minute). Configure trusted-edge admission and measure shared-proxy behavior before deciding application rates; do not blindly trust forwarded headers.

Canonical HTTPS VISUA_PUBLIC_URL controls secure __Host cookies, HSTS and the OIDC callback. Actual Google Workspace IdP registration, verified-email behavior, owner bootstrap and Cloudflare TLS/DNS remain deployment checks, not established by source review.

The S3 adapter accepts an operator endpoint, standard AWS credential chain, path-style option and explicit ChecksumSHA256 PUT followed by verified GET. Verify the exact sequence, private policy and chosen credential method with the candidate R2 account; no R2 compatibility or access has been established here.

Readiness bounds a shared SELECT 1 probe to 1 second and returns false while stopping. It does not check blob, IdP, web artifact or scheduler health. Collect structured diagnostics plus synthetic upload/download and sign-in monitoring.

Use stopped-writer coordinated database/object backups and new restore targets; code rollback alone cannot undo startup migrations. Secret custody, provider configuration, retention and measured RPO/RTO require operator records and a real restore drill.

Frozen pnpm lockfile and non-root runtime are positives. Base image remains a floating node:22-bookworm-slim tag, and the complete build /app tree including development dependencies is copied into runtime. Record immutable image digest/SBOM and scan both OS and all shipped packages; consider pruning build/test-only dependencies.

supply_chain_counterevidence: Lead production-dependency audit reports zero advisories. Full lockfile audit reports 8 high and 3 moderate advisories in development dependency chains; prior runtime package listing confirms ajv, fast-uri, source-map-js and uuid are present. Repository imports of ajv occur in export tests, and exceljs occurs in ingest tooling. No network-reachable affected call path was established, so these are not reported as exploitable application vulnerabilities.
